name: Terrarium 75x40x60
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 75x40x60 cm. Volume: 180 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: With 3000 cm² of floor, the 75x40x60 cm terrarium holds 180 liters. At 60 cm it is taller than most horizontal models, so it can be set up with branches and shelves above the floor. The ventilation is mesh, and there is no 3D background. With a 40 cm width it fits on a cabinet of standard depth.

A ball python uses a low branch and a hide on a shelf, which increases its area for moving around without a wider floor. Young tortoises and a blue-tongued skink stay on the floor, where they need deeper substrate. The height allows the lamp to be far from the animal, which reduces the risk of burns. A bearded dragon can live here only as a juvenile.

If you do not need the height, lower terrariums of similar length are the 70x40x35 and 80x40x45 +3D. The film on three sides is chosen from 34 patterns. We ship by courier to an address in Serbia. A size adapted to your space is built in 7 to 14 days.
